rules.label: Visitors: usually up to 6 months per entry
notes: The border officer decides how long you can stay and may allow less or more than 6 months. Check your passport stamp or visitor record.
Most visa-exempt travellers need an eTA to fly in; US citizens don't. Other passports need a visitor visa.
To stay longer, apply to extend before your status expires.

rules.label: Deemed resident: 183 days in a calendar year
notes: If you stay in Canada for 183 days or more in a calendar year, you can be a deemed resident for the whole year and taxed on your worldwide income. A tax treaty can change this.
Each day or part of a day in Canada counts.
Significant residential ties (a home, spouse or dependants in Canada) can make you resident with fewer days.
